notes.title: Update patch 1.1
notes.content:
- In the [b]Level Selection Room[/b] there are now numbers indicating the difficulty of each game, in addition to the light that was previously in focus for game 1.
- Increased the size of the [b]Reset button[/b] Trigger.
- Fixed a problem where you got stuck in the [b]elevator[/b] and had to press Click again to exit.
- Lowered the volume of the scream when you die to 0.2
- Speed adjustment when walking/running with Shift.

notes.title: 🔢 💣 🟥 🟩 ℂ𝕦𝕓𝕖𝕃𝕠𝕠𝕡 🔢 💣 🟥 🟩
notes.content:
[h1]ℂ𝕦𝕓𝕖𝕃𝕠𝕠𝕠𝕠𝕠𝕡[/h1].
[h2]CONDEMNATION[/h2].
In CubeLoop you are condemned to live in an infinite Loop and the only escape route from reality is a slide that seems to be connected to the canvas pieces that decorate the walls of your cell. 

[h2]SOS[/h2].
Entertainment will cost you dearly as every mistake could cost you your life.

[h2]ASK FOR HELP[/h2]
Still you are not alone, with your landline phone you can share doom with your friends to help you solve the riddles hidden behind all the frames.

[h3]ᴇɴᴛᴇʀ [🅃🄾 🄴🅂🄲🄰🄿🄴*][/h3]
